name: muster-codex-plugin
description: Show full-file live change context and an evidence-backed Kanban during Codex work without patching the Codex app.

interface.shortDescription: See complete files and coordinate agent work
interface.longDescription: Muster Live Work adds explicit-only Codex skills for full-file change visibility and evidence-backed task orchestration. It observes local tool events only while its skills are tagged, stores state outside repositories, and never patches the Codex app or existing threads.
defaultPrompt: $muster-live Show every command and the complete file after each edit.
$muster-board Create a board from the tasks in this prompt.
$muster-live $muster-board Work visibly and coordinate independent tasks.
